Messages.Author: technobabble66
Messages.Body:
Can't find an answer for this:
What happens if you steal a minion, say with Mind Rape, then get it to
play Baltimore Purge?
I think the minion returns to its controller with the card, but during
*your* untap phase the BP goes off as usual. And assuming u have a
lasombra, you still choose the minions that get dunked.
Is This Correct?

(... quietly gathering BP's, MR's & Stanislava in the background...)


Baltimore Purge
 Action
Requires a ready vampire.
If this vampire is Ravnos, this action is at +1 stealth. Put this card
on the acting vampire. During your untap phase, burn this card, and
each other Methuselah chooses a ready vampire he or she controls who
is not older than this vampire. If you control a ready Lasombra, you
choose the vampires instead. This vampire and the chosen vampires go
to torpor.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
On May 24, 11:48 pm, technobabble66 <stujaq...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> Can't find an answer for this:
> What happens if you steal a minion, say with Mind Rape, then get it to
> play Baltimore Purge?
> I think the minion returns to its controller with the card, but during
> *your* untap phase the BP goes off as usual. And assuming u have a
> lasombra, you still choose the minions that get dunked.
> Is This Correct?

No. Minion cards are controlled by the minion they're on. The *your*
will now refer to that minion's controller's untap phase and will go
off then.
